role: PolarBleSdk observer conformances on PolarManager (connection, device info, features, power, logger). Every callback is nonisolated, touches no manager state, and is reduced to a StrapEvent sent into StrapEventPump for ordered main-actor delivery by StrapLinkCoordinator.apply.
toplevel: Whole file is inside `#if canImport(PolarBleSdk)`; without the SDK none of the conformances exist. The deprecated `deviceDisconnected(_:pairingError:)` callback is deliberately not implemented (comment at :29-32).

units.does: Sends StrapEvent.connecting(deviceId) into the event pump.
units.entry: Polar SDK callback on the SDK's serial queue (com.emuqu.polarsdk); registered as observer in PolarManager.setupPolarApi (PolarManager.swift:538-542)

units.does: Sends StrapEvent.connected(deviceId, name, peripheralId: address) into the event pump.
